source: MTEB was created partly because evaluating only one task gives an incomplete picture. Its original benchmark covered eight task categories and found that no single method dominated every task in that evaluation. [16]
zh: 创建 MTEB 的部分原因是仅评估一项任务无法获得完整的图像。其最初的基准涵盖八个任务类别，发现没有单一方法主导该评估中的每项任务。 [16]
